resources.string: One safe place for the family\'s documents, cards and links.
No Google account was found on this device. Add one in Settings and try again.
Google did not finish the sign-in. Check your connection. If it keeps happening, the SHA-1 fingerprint of this build is missing in Firebase. See the setup steps in the README.
Google sign-in is not set up in this build. See the setup steps in the README.
Sign-in did not work. Check your connection and try again.
Your family sees it next to your documents. You can change it later in Settings.
Your family sees it next to your documents.
The name was not saved. Check your connection and try again.
If %1$s has an account, a link to choose a new password is on its way. Check spam too.
Wrong email or password. If you signed up with Google, use Continue with Google.
That email address doesn\'t look right.
This email already has an account. Sign in instead, or use Continue with Google if you signed up that way.
Choose a longer password, at least 6 characters.
Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and try again.
Email sign-in is not switched on in Firebase yet. See the setup steps in the README.
Your documents stay in the cloud. Sign in again to see them.

You leave every space and your documents are deleted with you. A space with nobody else in it is deleted. A space you share goes on without you; if you own it, the next adult becomes its owner. Your Google account is not touched. Google will ask you to choose your account once more.
Deleting did not work. Check your connection and that you chose the same Google account.
Tap the link we sent to %1$s. Until then, invites sent to that address can\'t reach you. Tap here to send it again.

You leave every space and your documents are deleted with you. A space with nobody else in it is deleted. A space you share goes on without you; if you own it, the next adult becomes its owner. You\'ll type your password once more.
Deleting did not work. Check your connection and your password.
An adult you share a space with can see your locked documents in an emergency. They ask, you are told and can say no, and after the wait they open them without your PIN.
No other adult shares a space with you yet.
Someone no longer in your spaces
Trusted person. Gets in %1$s after asking.
Asked for access. Gets in on %1$s unless you say no.
Can open your locked documents, and you are told each time.
People who trust you with their locked documents in an emergency:
Named you. You get in %1$s after asking, unless they say no.
You asked. You get in on %1$s unless they say no.
You can open their locked documents. They are told each time.
Open in your shared spaces for the next %1$d minutes.
Could not open. Check your connection; they may have said no.
Lock a document behind it. The other adults in your spaces then need the PIN to see it, and so do you.
Your locked documents stay yours alone until you unlock them.
Confirm it\'s you, then choose a new one.
Could not confirm it\'s you. Check your connection and that you chose the same Google account.
Could not confirm it\'s you. Check your connection and your password.
